terminals.name: dsh-web
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 22 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; exec pnpm dsh web --no-open
terminals.description: DeepSeek Harness Web UI (http://127.0.0.1:3080). Prints a tokenized URL on boot; restart this terminal to get a fresh token. Requires DEEPSEEK_API_KEY for model responses.
